question: Do eight source-selected inflammatory RNA directions recur in four fixed deposited-library post-injury/control contrasts, and how do barcode-depth weighting and source-derived RNA-only QC change them?
decision: Describe all fixed results and sensitivity without accepting a within-state, memory, pathway or population claim; keep original Q3/Q4/Q6 holds distinct from Q3a/Q5a execution.
strongest_rival: Sorting, lineage/genotype, composition, depth and processing explain whole-library differences without persistent within-state expression. Unknown pooled biological identities preclude population inference.
discriminator: Compare all-source RNA-denominator pooled CPM with equal-barcode mean CPM, transformed only after averaging, and the source RNA-only QC subset. Differences identify sensitivity to weighting/QC, not state composition versus within-state biology.
exposure_record: Published directions including Results Sec5/Fig3j and all prior metadata are exposed. Source-selected symbols and mt- feature labels were read before this freeze; no new RNA expression contrast was inspected. Parent authorization is 7d7b721f486a2be3af0593fb20011ef33cd6f416. Original source and metadata v1/v2 evidence remain immutable. Before freeze, bounded GSE329778 fragment headers revealed ARC 2.1.0/GRCm39-2024-A_TdTomato contrary to article/GEO ARC 2.0.2/mm10. This is source metadata exposure, not an accessibility result.
biological_unit: Deposited library as the descriptive observational unit; barcodes nested within each library describe its finite sample. Underlying pooled animal/preparation independence is unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Seven libraries, four accession-specific contrasts. GSE329778 LGR5/CTRL and KRT20/CTRL reuse CTRL. No across-accession control averaging, donor reconstruction, independent replication count or cell-based uncertainty.
population_and_selection: All seven deposited filtered-matrix barcode sets; positive all-source RNA depth primary. Secondary RNA-only QC uses 200<=detected genes<=2500, RNA>=500, mt- fraction<=0.40. This is not complete author joint QC or state selection.
contrast: GSE302685 irradiated-control (GEO Lgr5-associated); GSE302687 irradiated-control (GEO Krt20-associated); GSE329778 LGR5-CTRL; GSE329778 KRT20-CTRL. Preserve source run/sorting disagreements.
endpoint: For each of 31,950 common RNA IDs, post-minus-control log2(CPM+1) difference. Pooled CPM=1e6*gene counts/sum of ALL source RNA counts; equal CPM=mean positive-barcode 1e6*gene count/ALL source RNA depth, then log2(mean CPM+1). Panel of Cd74, Reg3g, Reg3b, H2-D1, App, Lgals9, Mif, Ifitm3; median and positive/zero/negative/held counts per contrast/case.
methods: Frozen rna_extension_v1.py and plot_rna_v1.py. Stream strict-column MatrixMarket and 128-column HDF5 blocks; positive RNA features only, no ATAC denominators, no dense full matrix. All-source and RNA-QC subsets each have pooled/equal weighting. Operational mt- source-symbol mapping must agree across all libraries. Eight synthetic tests before freeze; all source/common/target maps retained.
missingness_and_exclusions: Zero RNA depth excluded only from normalized summaries and enumerated. Empty subsets yield undefined fields and local holds. Ambiguous selected symbols hold only that target; missing/inconsistent mitochondrial labels hold RNA-QC only. No target replacement, arbitrary pseudocount for ratios or outcome-based filtering.
multiplicity: Fixed four contrasts x four cases; all 31,950 common stable IDs reported and the eight source-selected targets summarized. No inferential tests/FDR/CI, adaptive targets or added sensitivity cases.
precision_basis: Finite-library description with unknown biological unit independence; no population uncertainty or invented precision target.
interpretation_limit: Transformed-expression differences are not unqualified fold changes, pathway activity, persistent memory, state attribution, independent replication, causal effects or later functional prediction. QC and weighting agreement do not eliminate source selection/composition confounding. Cross-deposit reference/processing differences remain unresolved; no genomic interval transfer occurs in the RNA stable-ID comparisons.
stop_rule: Hash mismatch, changed common IDs, malformed counts or sparse axis mismatch stop execution. Symbol/mitochondrial/empty-subset problems yield explicitly scoped holds while eligible cases continue. Existing output directories are refused; corrections require new version and retained evidence. No Q4 accessibility endpoint under this contract.
amendment_reason: First biological endpoint version after reviewed metadata v1/v2 and parent Q3a/Q5a brief; no prior numerical endpoint is superseded.
